# NavigationOverlayKit integration for route instructions (2026-01-30 16:27Z)

_**User**_

when the user starts the navigation towards a device the route FROM the device towards the user is shown. At any point in time the user can switch the routes by pushing the switch button at the top to FROM his device towards the other device.

When the navigation is switched to the mode "from the current device towards the other device" I want to display navigation instructions and to do that use the https://github.com/bietiekay/NavigationOverlayKit  NavigationOverlayKit Framework.

Make a plan to implement this behaviour with all side effects and eventualities as well as changes to documentation, changelot etc.
